entries.title: Substituted flight controller with restricted origin
entries.expectedHandling: Payment hold on the line; noncompliant_substitution case; required approvers engineering (Mei) + controller (Dana); government-contract eligibility flagged. Not a price saving.
entries.note: Three-way match passes (price is below contract: info only); only the compliance check catches it. Invoice line says TW, certificate says CN — certificate is the system of record for origin. Expected duty on the customs entry is column 1 only until the CN × 8537.10.91 Chapter 99 entry is verified.

entries.title: Invoice price above contract (C-12 §4.2)
entries.expectedHandling: Hold the invoice; defend with C-12 §4.2; request a corrected invoice or a debit memo for the difference.

entries.title: Receipt quantity disagrees with packing slip and invoice
entries.expectedHandling: Hold; packing slip and invoice agree (600), so the dock receipt (660) is the outlier — ask receiving (Luis) to recount before paying. Impact = inventory overstated by 60 units.

entries.title: Duplicate invoice re-sent with a suffixed number
entries.expectedHandling: Block payment of the re-send; cite the original invoice; no new payment request.
entries.note: The re-send also fails three-way match (nothing received awaits invoicing).

entries.title: Atlas screws weighed 0.30% light (third month in a row)
entries.expectedHandling: Third short month in a row: the weight-count rule's exception applies — escalate (Raj to raise with Atlas).

hiddenRules.statement: Atlas M3 screws are counted by weight: accept the invoice quantity when the dock is short by 0.60% or less, unless it's the third short month in a row.
Hoshi rounds yen line totals down to ¥100: accept line differences under ¥100.
Cascade quantity disagreements are usually dock miscounts: ask receiving to recount before escalating.
Production supervisors fix late punches after approval: accept register hours up to 0.15 h over the approved timesheet.
Employee direct-deposit changes come only through HRIS self-service verified by HR; an email asking for a new account is held and escalated.
Remit-to changes are verified by calling the supplier on the number on file, then a vendor-change request to the controller; never from email.

decoys.description: Vireo late fees accepted twice — too little support to be a rule
Ridgeline year-end price accepted twice — explicitly one-off
Northwind freight lines — mixed outcomes, depends on who asked for expediting
Sales commission adjustments accepted three times — too little support to be a rule
Trap: Dana approved an emailed bank change once; it was a near-miss. Never a rule to approve bank changes.

payroll.title: Ghost employee in the preview register
payroll.expectedHandling: Hold the line; E-9107 isn't in the HRIS and is paid into Omar Xu's account (…4118). Escalate to the controller and HR; never pay a person HR hasn't hired.

payroll.title: Terminated employee still paid
payroll.expectedHandling: Hold; HRIS shows Grace Fujita terminated 2026-05-08, before the period started 2026-05-11. No approved timesheet.

payroll.title: Raise not applied
payroll.expectedHandling: Underpayment: HRIS raise to $36.00/h effective 2026-06-08 (period start). Correct before approval or pay the difference off-cycle.

payroll.title: Overtime paid at straight time
payroll.expectedHandling: FLSA exposure: 50 h in week one owes 10 h at 1.5×, even though the period totals 80 h. Correct before approval.
payroll.note: Withholding on the provider line is left as the provider computed it on the correct gross; the gross/OT gap is the finding.

payroll.title: Social Security withheld past the $184,500 wage base
payroll.expectedHandling: Over-withheld (employee and employer share). Only the wages up to the base are taxable this run (Pub 15 2026 p.29). Correct before approval.

payroll.title: 401(k) deferral past the $24,500 limit
payroll.expectedHandling: Excess deferral (employee under 50, no catch-up). Cap the deferral at the remaining room; excess must not reach the plan.

payroll.title: Employee now works in Oregon; Kestrel isn't registered there
payroll.expectedHandling: Escalate to the controller and HR: Oregon withholding and registration aren't set up. Don't compute Oregon tax; don't ignore it.

payroll.title: Off-cycle reissue paid again in the regular run
payroll.expectedHandling: Remove the line from the regular run (already paid by the Jul 8 off-cycle reissue). Never pay the same period twice.
